panels.description: Distinguishes CURRENT Prometheus state, SELECTED RUN HTTP evidence, and selected-range history for Pipeline and Run Type. Run ID never filters Prometheus; Stage and collection states are context, not delivery proof. UNKNOWN means evidence is incomplete Run coverage: IN RANGE / OUT OF RANGE / UNKNOWN. Set range to run when OUT OF RANGE. Effective refresh: 60s · timezone: browser. Effective filters: stage=${stage} · provider_hint=${provider_hint}.

options.content: CURRENT · Pipeline / Run Type. INCOMPLETE / UNKNOWN: expected stage evidence is unverified. Check Expected stage signals, then open Review Stage Progress below. SCRAPING is not an active blocker. None observed does not prove completeness or health.

panels.title: Monitor Pipeline Status
panels.description: CURRENT · Shows the sole current Pipeline Health verdict. Status mapping: 0=OK, 1=WARN, >=2=CRIT, null=UNKNOWN. A telemetry gap makes the verdict incomplete; use First Action and Runtime Blockers to continue. This CURRENT pipeline verdict is not exact-run processing_status or trust_status.

CURRENT snapshot · Blockers for the selected Pipeline and Run Type at evaluation time; not a Selected Run ID result. Shows up to 3 reasons. An empty list is healthy only when Pipeline Health is OK and Metrics Coverage is complete; otherwise it is inconclusive. Open the matching detection or localization panel. TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY.
panels.title: Review Runtime Blockers

panels.description: CURRENT · Endpoint is scrape availability. Expected stage signals is presence of lag/backlog for every expected pipeline/run_type stage. Missing stage definitions remain UNKNOWN. Rule age is evaluation age, not event freshness. Presence alone does not prove a live process. Missing signals make evidence confidence inconclusive. Rule age is the oldest required group; missing groups return UNKNOWN.
panels.title: Monitor Metrics Coverage

panels.description: CURRENT stage snapshots and TIME RANGE-independent 5m throughput. Maximum observed value per stage across selected run types; inspect one Run Type for exact values. Missing signals remain UNKNOWN. An active blocker is not established by missing evidence. INCOMPLETE: inspect expected-stage evidence; no observed blocker is not proof of coverage.

Verify /health/live and continue in Run Explorer Inspect value opens full identifiers as selectable plain text.

defaults.noValue: SELECT RUN — no exact Run ID selected. Choose a run first.

panels.title: Inspect Processed Records
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · TIME RANGE · Shows HTTP-backed Bronze input, Silver accepted/rejected, and Gold output counts and outcomes. Zero is a recorded count. No matching rows can mean a valid empty result, unresolved scope, or backend failure (backend unavailable); verify /health/live and use Run Explorer before classifying the result. Counts and percentages are neutral accounting quantities, not quality verdicts. Exclusions alone have no severity threshold here; assess the DQ verdict and contract evidence. Percentages use the same precision (at least one decimal, up to three for small shares).

defaults.noValue: SELECT RUN — no exact Run ID selected. Choose a run in Inspect Recent Runs.

panels.title: Review Selected Run Status
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Saved evidence for the exact Run ID. Completion age and chart range do not change this verdict. CURRENT uses fresh telemetry and retains its 15-minute freshness rule. Historical Trust never authorizes replay now. Missing checks are INCOMPLETE; missing selection is SELECT RUN; request failure is QUERY ERROR. N/A means explicitly inapplicable. VALID EMPTY is an empty successful query; backend down is QUERY ERROR. Chart coverage is separate: use Set range to run in Run Explorer to inspect a partial or outside range. Inspect the report for rules, revision, completion and the saved source evidence.
